cli.send_help.send: Send a message to another local lop session (no cmux needed)
cli.send_help.target: conversation-name / session-id / cwd substring (case-insensitive). Omit when addressing with --pid/--session; passing both is refused.
cli.send_help.message: message text; omit to read the body from stdin. With --pid/--session a single positional IS the message, and typing one while also piping a body is refused.
cli.send_help.steer: inject mid-turn (steer) instead of the default mailbox
cli.send_help.wake: if the target is idle, drive a turn now (mailbox mode only)
